thread:
Leo: Heads-up — saw a perf regression when I ran the new multi-phase synth with nested bursts on a7x nodes. Kernel selector flips to generic matmul around seq=512 and p95 doubles.
Tanvi: Can you paste the profiler snippet? curious if this is batching related or KV warmup knock-on.
Leo: quick profile excerpt:
```
[2026-03-18T15:02:12Z] kernel_selector: model=redwood-open-7b selected=matmul_generic cost=12.4 fallback_reason=quant_hint
[2026-03-18T15:02:12Z] runtime: p95=180ms p50=45ms p99=360ms
[2026-03-18T15:02:12Z] batching: distribution batch_size=1: 62% batch_size=2: 20% batch_size=4+: 18%
[2026-03-18T15:02:12Z] kv: cache_miss_rate=0.47 prewarm_hit=false
```
Maria: Oof. That `quant_hint` path shouldn't be the fast path. What did the synth generator use for batching heuristics?
Leo: here's the load config I used:
```
phases:
  - ramp: {start_qps: 5, end_qps: 600, duration_s: 120}
  - microbursts: {qps: 2800, burst_count: 8, burst_len_s: 3}
batching:
  max_batch_wait_ms: 6
  prefer_static_batch_sizes: false
kv:
  prewarm_prefix_fraction: 0.15
  prewarm_strategy: none
arrival_jitter: poisson
seed: 12431
```
Devon: I suspect the low `prewarm_prefix_fraction` is causing KV misses which produce a bunch of single-request batches while the runtime waits for KV to populate. Small batches => kernel fallback. Try raising prewarm to ~0.5-0.7 and switch arrival_jitter to a gated sawtooth to smooth the long-tail.
Ryan: Agree. Also our poisson jitter produces lots of microbursts that stress the kernel selector heuristics differently than steady ramps. Add a shaped waveform option (gated_sawtooth) to the generator and compare.
Tanvi: For apples-to-apples we must fix: same seed, same model checksum, same quantization artifacts, and identical per-request payloads. Leo can you run replay harness with kv_prewarm toggled and arrival_jitter=gated_sawtooth?
Leo: running now. Command: `./harness/replay --seed 12431 --waveform gated_sawtooth --kv-prewarm 0.6 --keep-checksum 20260305-rc1`
Leo: quick numbers — baseline (default synth) p95=185ms p50=48ms kernel_fallback_rate=4.7%
Leo: with kv_prewarm=0.6 + gated_sawtooth p95=98ms p50=44ms kernel_fallback_rate=0.6%
ops-bot: deploy-bot: test-run 4387654321 completed — artifact sgen-20260318-9 stored at s3://redwood-ci/synth-runs/4387654321/
Maria: If this reproduces consistently, it's a defaults problem in the synth generator. We should change the default prewarm fraction and document kernel-selection sensitivity. Also add a regression test that fails if kernel_fallback_rate > 1% under a standard harness.
Devon: I'll draft an RFC + small unit test that runs a short gated_sawtooth scenario and asserts kernel_fallback_rate < 1%. @Ryan can you add the new waveform and expose `seed`/`kv_prewarm` as top-level CLI params?
Ryan: Yep — I'll push a PR today with the waveform, seed plumbing, and an example config. Will also add a tiny perf dashboard comparing runs (kernel selection, batch dist, kv miss).
Leo: attaching flamegraphs and tarball to the ticket in a follow-up comment. Thanks all.
